source_title: Genomic analyses of flow-sorted Hodgkin Reed-Sternberg cells reveal complementary mechanisms of immune evasion
notes: Reported TMB 7.66 mut/Mb in 23 newly diagnosed classical Hodgkin lymphomas with flow-sorted HRS cells and paired normal B cells. Statistic of this exact prose value is unspecified; Figure 7B orders cancer cohorts by median coding mutations/Mb but separates EBV strata. Not a clinical-panel cohort, not all Hodgkin histologies, and not evidence that cHL is uniformly low-TMB. Replaces the unsupported 2.0 WES claim and unrelated panel cohort; source statistic not relabeled as mean or median.

source_title: Genomic profiling of mycosis fungoides identifies patients at high risk of disease progression
notes: Best-effort CTCL proxy: published median 3.5 mut/Mb in 67 mycosis fungoides skin samples from 48 patients, including repeated/sequential samples. WES SNVs and indels with tumor-only filtering. This is a specimen-level MF median, not an aggregate over all CTCL entities. Independent Sezary mean 2.75 nonsynonymous mut/Mb remains in the alternative ledger; no medians or means were pooled. Original citation for 3.0 was unrelated.

source_title: Cell-of-Origin Patterns Dominate the Molecular Classification of 10,000 Tumors from 33 Types of Cancer
notes: Calculated from 36 unique mutation-profile-eligible patients with SUBTYPE=BRCA_Normal in pinned TCGA PanCancer Atlas portal data: median 1.283333333 and mean 1.925925926 mut/Mb (curated 1.28 and 1.93). Uses portal-provided nonsynonymous TMB without independent callable-base reconstruction; not a median published in the cited paper. Expression-defined normal-like can reflect nonneoplastic admixture and is not TNBC. Different release from the eight normal-like cases excluded by TCGA 2012. Source hashes, sample extraction and reproduction script are in docs/audits.

source_title: EGFR mutation subtypes and response to immune checkpoint blockade treatment in non-small-cell lung cancer
notes: Best-effort LUAD_EGFR proxy: explicitly reported median 3.8 and mean 5.6 nonsynonymous mut/Mb in 383 EGFR-mutant lung cancers, irrespective of treatment history. MSK n=313, Yale n=17, TCGA n=53; mixed panels/WES with platform-specific captured coding denominators. Broader lung cohort not verified as exclusively adenocarcinoma. This is separate from the 171-patient ICI-treated cohort; not an ICI response statistic. Replaces unrelated original citation for 3.5.

source_title: Exome Sequencing in Classic Hairy Cell Leukaemia Reveals Widespread Variation in Acquired Somatic Mutations between Individual Tumours Apart from the Signature BRAF V(600)E Lesion
notes: Approximate 0.2 mut/Mb from five classic HCL exomes: unflagged nonsynonymous counts 10,22,7,10,4 have median 10; divide by nominal 44.1-50 Mb capture sizes to obtain 0.20-0.23. Not a published TMB median or an independently validated callable-coding rate; sample-specific platform assignments and callable intersections are unavailable. Restrictive variant filtering matters: all candidate nonsynonymous counts 19,32,14,34,19 yield 0.38-0.43 by the same approximation. Ranges describe method sensitivity, not confidence intervals. Same rounded point as the withdrawn 0.2, with a different source and explicit approximate provenance.
